structured_output.summary: The diff implements Atomics.compareExchange in its own file and follows the spec steps in order. Each step keeps its spec comment above the code. Argument coercion goes through helpers, and ValidateAtomicAccessOnIntegerTypedArray, RevalidateAtomicAccess, NumericToRawBytes and RawBytesToNumeric are all called before the compare-and-store. The byte comparison matches ByteListEqual. The three lint flags are acceptable. The two expect("not detached") calls are unreachable in practice, because RevalidateAtomicAccess has already rejected detached and out-of-bounds buffers and no user code runs between that check and the read. The unreachable! is guarded by the object check inside ValidateIntegerTypedArray. The gate shows 24 new passes, 0 regressions and no special-casing. The remaining failures come from Atomics.load and Atomics.store being unimplemented in the test bodies, not from this change.
